messages:
Samira Khan: FYI flagged an abrupt drop for Kitterly after their CTO change. seat activity down ~60% last 7d.
Theo Park: doh. was there an intro from AE?
Samira Khan: nope, AE handed off in Feb and didn't make a CTO intro. emails not returned.
Priya Shah: I checked telemetry  last successful requests = 4 days ago. etl-sync pipeline failing w/ 502 on retry.
Samira Khan: pasted a quick snapshot to their workspace: 
```
active_seats: 12 (was 31)
avg_tokens/day: 10k (was 46k)
etl-sync failures: 4 in 9d
most-called model: rdl-3-13b (zero calls last 72h)
```
Theo Park: any procurement noise about VendorX or other vendors?
Samira Khan: procurement asked for VendorX POC last week, mentioned "lower latency at scale".
Priya Shah: we need to split technical vs commercial triage. tech: offer a focused remediation session to fix etl-sync and run perf traces. commercial: check renewal date and if we can offer a short dedicated trial credit.
Theo Park: renewal is in 9w. I'll ping procurement/legal about a 30-day Dedicated credit and see if AM can join the CTO intro.
Samira Khan: good. propose immediate 30-min troubleshooting call with their new CTO + eng lead. Priya, can you draft a one-page "what to bring" for the session?
Priya Shah: drafting now. checklist items to request: logs (last 72h), sample payloads hitting long-seq path, token size histogram, service config (quantization, dtype flags), preferred time slots.
ops-bot: incident INC-9002 created: etl-sync failure spike for customer=kitterly at 2026-03-19T11:04:12Z.
Theo Park: Nora (cc'd) can you pick the remediation runbook and give time estimate?
Priya Shah: runbook selected: etl-retry-and-params. reproduce + fix = ~2hrs, workshop prep = 45min.
Samira Khan: action list: Samira -> send outreach now, Theo -> commercial check (48h), Priya -> reproduce & checklist (48h). schedule sync Fri 11am PT?
Theo Park: Thurs/ Fri ok. I'll chase legal over DM for the trial credit.
Priya Shah: will start reproducing now and post logs here. if it's config we can push a patch and restart, usually restores ~90% traffic.
Samira Khan: perfect. I'll include a soft ask about VendorX evaluation in the outreach. please keep updates here so I can prep a customer-friendly summary after remediation. :thumbsup:
Theo Park: noted. will update with procurement reply.
Priya Shah: quick note  if we can show perf delta on our Dedicated cluster in the workshop, might address their latency concern.
Samira Khan: agree. let's try to have a small perf comparison ready for the call (tail latency numbers).
